content: MK's summary: after an attempt on Shāhrukh's life in 830/1427 by a Hurufi assassin, 'possibly staged by the Timurid ruler himself', Ṣāʾin al-Dīn was recalled to the capital and, on the basis of his claimed Hurufi sympathies, summarily stripped of position and property, imprisoned, tortured and exiled.
